vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.7

The skill bundle defines a customer support persona that utilizes Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Sheets, Chat, Calendar) via the 'gws' utility. The instructions in SKILL.md are entirely consistent with the stated purpose of managing support tickets and do not contain any malicious commands, data exfiltration attempts, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions and requirements match its stated purpose (managing support via Google Workspace commands), but it depends on an external 'gws' binary and companion gws-* skills from unknown sources — verify those before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (customer support: triage, convert emails to tasks, log to sheets, escalate to chat, schedule calls) align with the SKILL.md workflows and required binary 'gws' and companion skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar). No unrelated binaries or env vars are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to calling gws commands and workflows against Gmail/Sheets/Chat/Calendar. They do not request arbitrary file reads or unrelated system state. However, the SKILL.md requires loading additional gws-* skills — those companion skills will likely request Google credentials and scopes, so inspect them too.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with no install spec and no code files, so nothing will be written to disk by the skill itself. Risk depends on the external 'gws' binary (required) and how you obtain it.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars itself, which is consistent, but it depends on gws and companion gws-* skills that almost certainly require Google credentials/OAuth tokens. Confirm those companion skills' requested scopes and credential handling before granting access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and model invocation is allowed (default). The skill does not request persistent system-wide presence or special privileges in its metadata.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent for a Google-Workspace-based support persona, but before installing: 1) Verify the 'gws' binary is from a trusted source (official vendor/repo) — do not install an unknown binary into your PATH. 2) Inspect the companion skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) — they will likely request OAuth credentials and API scopes for Gmail, Sheets, Chat, Calendar; make sure requested scopes are minimal and acceptable. 3) Because the skill is instruction-only, the security surface comes from the external tools and companion skills; review their code or publisher reputation. 4) If you plan to grant this skill agent autonomy, consider limiting its account permissions (use a service account or narrowly-scoped OAuth tokens) and testing in a non-production environment first. 5) Note there is no homepage and the skill source is unknown — if you need higher assurance, request provenance or prefer skills published by known vendors.
